name: Pen-led stroke

source.description: Five inspected references draw lines with a visible moving point at the tip (a dot, a heartbeat blip, an accent full stop).

technique: A line is drawn by a visible point that travels ahead of it, so the line reads as the trace of an action (a pen, a pulse, a flight) rather than as a mask reveal. The point usually survives the stroke and becomes the next focal element.
purpose: Give lines agency and direction; carry attention along a path; hand off to the next beat from the dot.
visual_behaviour: A small dot appears, moves along a path and leaves the stroke behind it; it may stop at the end, bounce, or bloom into the next scene.
mechanics: Dash-offset reveal and dot position share one eased progress (ease-in-out or sine), so the dot stays on the tip; speeds of about 400-900 px/s.

decomposition.timing: Observed strokes of 0.6-2 s (ref-49459ad8c1 question-mark stroke about 1 s; ref-5924215625 heartbeat line about 1.5 s).

parameters.name: speed or duration
parameters.description: Pen speed in px/s or a fixed time

parameters.name: keepDot
parameters.description: Leave the dot at the end for the next beat

failure_modes: Dot drawn with a different ease from the line drifts off the tip
Very fast pens (>1200 px/s) make the dot invisible
Several pens at once divide attention

implementation.approach: Studio.draw.pen: dash-offset draw plus a circle whose cx/cy follow piecewise-linear tweens sampled evenly in time and in arc length at the same eased progress (no MotionPathPlugin, no callbacks).

resources.memory: about 60 attribute tweens per second of drawing

measurements.what: every-frame preview capture of tests/reference-derived/pen-and-bloom, 1280x720, 285 frames
measurements.value: 52.5 ms/frame median, peak headless Chromium 264 MB

measurements.what: dot-to-tip distance at 8 sampled times on a 1229 px path

additional_tooling.justification: GSAP MotionPathPlugin would be equivalent but is not needed.

limitations: Path transforms belong on a parent group (the dot copies only the path's own transform attribute)

provenance.observed: An orange dot draws a question-mark line that tangles into a scribble; later a line runs from the dot to underline the closing sentence.
A heartbeat trace is drawn by a moving blip at the start and returns flat at the end.
An orange swoosh draws under the closing title and retracts to a dot.
A spiral construction line is traced with an accent dot at its tip over an archival image (approx., from overview spacing).

evidence.notes: Contact sheet inspected: dot leads the line; underline drawn from the reveal point.
Pen-drawn fold lines and a 2 s flight path whose dot becomes the bloom source. Frame review 0 errors, 0 warnings (preview grade).

combines_with.why: The surviving dot becomes the seed of the next scene.
One pen line can run through several scenes.

licensing_notes: Technique only, learned from user-supplied references (inspiration-only, rights unknown). Paths and copy in the tests are original.
